decision: Music v2 re-timed: segment edges snapped to the measured 160.00 BPM click lattice (src L(j)=0.1239+0.375j s; drops j97/129/169) and each segment resampled x1.00222 (3.8 cents slower) instead of cutting at the direction's grid times 0.37583 s apart
why: the track's kick clicks run at exactly 0.375 s; the direction grid drifted -1 ms per beat (-45 ms by m46) and its join phases were 6-9 ms off, so cuts at round(T*30) landed up to 57 ms after the clicks. After the fix every click lands on T(m) within 5 ms and all picture cuts stay as directed (max cut-vs-click error 14.8 ms, half frame = 16.7)

decision: Sync metric: cut-vs-click (hi band >2.5 kHz half-rise) is the reported error; the 35-110 Hz 30 % half-rise is not used as the pass criterion
why: on this track the kick-band half-rise sits 30-85 ms after the click (sub swell after a sidechain dip) and flips between neighbouring 16th kicks (rolling pattern), so it is unstable; the click is what the ear and the direction's own broadband half-rise measure lock to

decision: ive assemble: prepared clips are exact-length 1080x1920 mp4s (no dur:), first clip one frame short (21 frames) and the logo one frame long (32)
why: measured: with exact clips every cut landed one frame late; with the first clip short every shot starts on its direction frame (checked by matching each shot's first frame in the assembled file) and the reel is 798 frames
